description.narrative: The project will re-orient women toward market-oriented production, including handicrafts and farm produce, to stabilize incomes. Financial inclusion will be promoted through accessible savings and borrowing systems, complemented by micro-insurance to protect against social and enterprise risks. Strengthening cooperatives will ensure good governance, enabling women to manage ventures and represent community interests effectively. Beyond economic empowerment, the project emphasizes gender equality, food security, and improved living standards by supporting women's rights to land ownership and sustainable livelihoods. Media engagement will amplify awareness, influence policy, and promote inclusive agricultural growth. Ultimately, the project seeks to enhance resilience, incomes, and empowerment, ensuring stronger families and communities while addressing challenges of poverty, food insecurity, and climate change.
